title: Gated Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.28350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Realistic few-shot adaptation of medical vision-language models (VLMs) can leave low-prevalence classes without any labeled support. The training-free SS- Text+ solver remains operational in this setting, but its zero-support prototypes receive no visual adaptation and fall back to a purely textual class prototype. We in- troduce Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (GProtoT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation. In 50 paired realistic one-shot trials on MESSIDOR with FLAIR features, severe and proliferative diabetic retinopathy were absent from every support set. Relative to SS-Text+, gated ProtoT improved missing-class recall by 5.23 points, average class accuracy by 1.37 po

translated_title: 面向零支持样本医学视觉语言模型的门控原型迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28350v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的现实少样本适应场景中，低患病率类别可能完全没有带标签的支持样本。免训练的 SS-Text+ 求解器在这种设置下仍可运行，但其零支持样本的原型无法获得视觉适应，只能退回到纯文本的类别原型。我们提出了门控知识引导原型迁移，这是一个前置排斥模块，利用 VLM 相似度和基于本体的临床距离，将有支持类别的视觉残差迁移到缺失类别。一个无需验证的证据门控根据语义相关性和残差一致性来调节迁移幅度，从而限制无依据的外推。在 MESSIDOR 数据集上使用 FLAIR 特征进行的 50 组配对现实单样本试验中，重度与增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变在所有支持集中均未出现。与 SS-Text+ 相比，门控 ProtoT 将缺失类别的召回率提升了 5.23 个百分点，平均类别准确率提升了 1.37 个百分点。
tldr: 提出GProtoT门控原型迁移方法，利用VLM相似度与临床本体距离将有支持类别的视觉残差迁移到零支持缺失类别，并通过免验证的证据门控限制无依据外推，使医学VLM在零支持场景下缺失类别召回率提升5.23个百分点。
en_tdlr: GProtoT is a gated prototype transfer module that moves visual residuals from supported classes to zero-support missing classes via VLM similarity and ontology-based clinical distance, with a validation-free evidence gate limiting unsupported extrapolation, boosting missing-class recall by 5.23 points over SS-Text+.
